verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth documents its own token sync and backup through iCloud or Google Drive, plus export files, so tokens survive phone loss and can be recovered on another device. That is a direct portability capability. However, nothing describes a single guided phone-to-phone migration flow, and the platform-specific clouds leave cross-platform moves only implied through export files. Missing for 10: a documented one-step guided transfer to a new phone, an explicit restore-on-new-device walkthrough for Auth tokens, cross-platform (iOS↔Android) migration guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Synchronize your Tokens with 2FAS export files, iCloud or Google Drive.
You can enable secure data syncing with your personal iCloud or Google Drive to protect yourself from losing Tokens in case of phone damage or loss.
Even if you lose your mobile device, you can recover service keys because they are stored in a secure cloud backup.
